fields.label: Callback URL
fields.description: Where the mock POSTs the FT callback. Empty = this site's titan_kcb callback endpoint.

fields.label: Callback Site Header
fields.description: Optional. Value for the X-Frappe-Site-Name header; empty = current site name.

fields.label: Consumer Key
fields.description: Optional override. Normally leave empty: the mock reads kcb_mock_consumer_key / kcb_mock_consumer_secret from site_config.json.

fields.label: Consumer Secret
fields.description: Optional override. Normally leave empty: the mock reads kcb_mock_consumer_key / kcb_mock_consumer_secret from site_config.json.
